t: Introduction and overview — Oliver Hazard Perry-class Frigate
name: Introduction and overview — Oliver Hazard Perry-class Frigate — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Oliver Hazard Perry-class Frigate
description: Introduction and overview of the Oliver Hazard Perry-class Frigate: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Oliver Hazard Perry class — 71 built for the U.S. and allies — was the affordable Cold War escort frigate: 4,100 tons with a Mk 13 missile launcher, 76mm gun, and two helicopters. 'Figs' served worldwide; the last U.S. ship retired in 2015, but many serve on with allies. Baseline facts: U.S./allied frigate; 71 built; Mk 13 launcher; 4,100 tons; Cold War escort..
